zones.description: waiting area in the lanes immediately before the stop line where cars queue

lines.description: stop line at the edge of the crosswalk; from bottom to top of the image, moving upward across the line

assumptions: Cars travel from the bottom of the image toward the top toward the intersection/crosswalk.
The stop line is the southern edge of the pedestrian crosswalk.
The line is placed just south of the zebra stripes and north of the BUS road marking.
The line is drawn straight across the full width of the traffic lanes that approach the crosswalk.
The waiting zone is the lane area immediately south of the stop line on the approach side.
The top edge of the zone coincides with/touches the stop line.
The zone extends south far enough to contain queuing cars including the BUS lane.

zones.description: waiting area in the traffic lanes immediately before the stop line where cars queue before the crosswalk

lines.description: stop line at the edge of the crosswalk across the traffic lanes; moving upward from the bottom of the image toward the top across the line

assumptions: road runs roughly bottom-to-top on the right side of the image with crosswalk across it in the upper third
cars travel from bottom of image toward top, lead vehicle front facing top and stopped at crosswalk edge
stop line placed at southern/downstream edge of crosswalk parallel to crosswalk edge across both traffic lanes
line endpoints at left and right edges of the trafficked lanes to cover full width
waiting zone is the lane area immediately south of the line on the approach side, touching the line along its full length and extending ~2 car lengths upstream to capture queuing cars

zones.description: waiting area covering the car traffic lanes immediately upstream of the stop line

lines.description: stop line across the car lanes; vehicles travel from top of image toward bottom and cross the line in the top-to-bottom direction

assumptions: No painted stop line is visible in the first frame, so a proxy stop line was placed near the bottom of the image where cars exit the view.
Travel direction inferred as top-to-bottom because car fronts and headlights face the camera, indicating oncoming movement toward the camera.
Line placed horizontally across all motor-vehicle lanes to apply to every car.
Zone placed immediately upstream of the line on the approach side, with its bottom edge coincident with the line so it touches the line.
Zone lateral extent set to cover car and bus lanes while excluding the left-side red bicycle track.
Zone longitudinal extent set to provide observable waiting area upstream of the line.

zones.description: waiting area on the roadway immediately before the stop line covering all approach lanes

lines.description: stop line across all approach lanes; from top of image toward bottom of image across the line

assumptions: Travel direction inferred as top-to-bottom in image from lane arrows pointing downward and distant car front facing toward camera
No clearly painted stop bar visible so stop line placed near lower part of view at y=0.85 as downstream boundary for the rule
Line drawn across full approach carriageway from x=0.05 to x=0.98 to cover all car lanes the rule applies to
Zone placed immediately upstream of the line on the approach side, touching the line along its top edge of zone to bottom edge coincidence
Zone upstream extent to y=0.55 chosen to provide sufficient waiting area depth for 1.5 second dwell before crossing

zones.description: waiting area on the carriageway immediately before the stop line where cars must wait

lines.description: stop line across all traffic lanes that cars must not cross until after waiting; vehicles move from bottom to top of the image, entering the zone at its lower edge and exiting across the line at its up

assumptions: No painted stop line is visible so a virtual stop line was placed across the carriageway at mid-distance.
Travel direction inferred as bottom-to-top from painted lane arrows pointing toward top of image and visible vehicle rears.
Line was drawn to span the full width of the car lanes from left to right.
Zone was placed on the approach side where vehicles come from, i.e. immediately south/below the line.
Top edge of zone was made coincident with the line so the zone touches the line.
Zone bottom and lateral extents were chosen to cover all car lanes over a length sufficient to observe a 1.5s wait, excluding most of the left red bike/pedestrian strip.
